programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Rayo Vallecano - Valencia 21.11.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: 13 Hours to Survive
programme.desc: S01 E02 — Escape to the DeepThe sun sets and predators prowl around the pool before the tide finally rolls in; persevere as night falls with a kleptomaniacal slug and an acrobatic scallop; a pair of sneaky crabs take a dangerous shot at romance.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives
programme.desc: S01 E03 — LeopardsBattle harsh environments and relentless challenges and see how the leopard constantly outthinks its enemies to secure food and protect its young. Cross icy peaks and arid riverbeds, where any encounter can change this cat's fate for better or worse.

programme.title: Planet Weird
programme.desc: S01 E03 — VillainsNature's most wanted species don't get the respect they deserve, including the great white shark's electrical sensors, the razor-sharp limbs of the dead leaf mantis and the zombie-creating powers of cordyceps fungi.

programme.title: Planet Weird

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: It's a no-holds-barred battle to the death for possession of the invaluable Purple Sword. Assistant director Wang Po-yi also wrote this entertaining and exciting adventure.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: The fabulous tale of a frostbitten swordswoman out to get her parents' murderers.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Several years before GHOSTBUSTERS was a massive Hollywood hit, Wong Jing scripted this hilarious supernatural action comedy starring Alexander Fu and directed by Lau Ka Wing.

programme.title: The Blue And The Black Part 2
programme.desc: War and time change everything. Their love becomes more than reunion, it becomes a reckoning with what was and what could've been.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Martial arts legend Chan Koon Tai plays a city gang leader, who runs his operation out of a local cafe in this gritty, crime drama from director Kuei Chih Hung.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: The Sung Dynasty army's Chief Instructor is on a danger-fraught pilgrimage to the Tung Yueh Temple.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: Beloved cult director Kueh Chih Hung delivers this deranged romantic tragedy centring on muscular demon Lo Meng, whose attempts to possess the soul of his true love backfire.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: There is an old grudge between families among the Ching and Ming supporters in Kwang Tung. Some years later, Liang's son Hsiao-hu returns to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: Humiliated swordsman Chin Wu-hsin is charged with finding the Supreme Sword of Old Eagle, only to retrieve it using foul play. This leads Old Eagle's own son to avenge his father.

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng flees to San Francisco after he is framed for drug possession. He assists Philip Kwok's notorious White Dragons in a vicious gang war, only to then be betrayed.

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Perennial martial-arts villain Shek Kin takes on a rare comedic role as a playful ghost who befriends a young boy and helps him reunite his feuding parents.

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Lily Ho portrays the feared swordswoman Silver Fox, who witnessed her father senselessly wounded and her mother raped. 18 years later it's payback time.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei stars as a young singer, Hsiao-Yun, struggles between her success in career and her relationship with her pianist lover Li Yen-nan.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-Killer
programme.desc: A wealthy womanizer writes a diary about his romantic escapades, but the women with whom he’s been intimate have all been murdered.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and taking revenge.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Hsiao Fang is a young girl not afraid to fight back against hooligans. Unfortunately, she mistakes the handsome Ma Ta-hai, for one such hoodlum. The two are immediately attracted but refuse to admit their true feelings.

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: A dedicated wife uncovers a web of blackmail and deceit after her husband is conned by a conniving belly dancer. When the dancer is stabbed, things quickly go from bad to insane.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu depicts the glamourous world of nightclub performers in this story about two struggling sisters, played by Irene Chen Yi Ling and Betty Ting Pei.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong.

programme.title: The Kung-Fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: The Monkey King and his gang are confronted by the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her two sexy sisters, plus a cast of fanciful characters.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: The story evolves around Lin Shao-teh, a poor student who was engaged to Chien-king, the daughter of billionaire Wang Chun.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and his fiance to help escort gold to the capital. The duo run into a mysterious knight along the way and prevent bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: When the Emperor is killed and the throne is usurped by Lord 9, his two baby princes are entrusted to the care of three Shaolin monks and the premier.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon.

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: A schizophrenic who refuses to believe her pilot lover was killed and believes his death to be a lie created to end their relationship.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Acclaimed actor Danny Lee plays a motorbike workshop owner who injured during an illegal motorcycle race and continues to race regardless of the physical consequences and the law.

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and she confronts him when she finds herself pregnant.

programme.title: To Kill A Mastermind
programme.desc: A ruthless crime syndicate, Qi Sha clan, which is controlled by seven chiefs is terrorizing China. The Imperial Court orders Minister Yang to bring them down by sending undercovers to the clan.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Roving swordsman Tu Meng-Fei chances to rescue a female pupil Mu Wan-Erh and later, another girl Li Sai-Nan from underworld leader Leng Tien-Lei. Li wants to take vengeance on Leng who murdered her parents.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: In Pale Passion, Chin Ping-hsings only directed film, the gorgeous Chiang Li-ping plays a scorned wife Ah Hsia in an unsettling tale about cheating, adultery and blatant abuse, which develops into a deadly love triangle.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: A sickly wife and maid conspire to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: An unparalleled kung-fu masterpiece from the one and only Chang Cheh. The dying Poison Clan master sends his last pupil on a dangerous mission to hunt down the five titular warriors.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: Chou Lian Huan is good at fist fighting in Shanghai. In order to please a hostess named Chen Ju Fang, he is willing to sacrifice everything and fight against the son of the gang leader in Shanghai.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My 12 Lovers?
programme.desc: Six guitar playing, rock and roll singing and dancing young people on a boating trip are stranded on a rural island off of Hong Kong during a typhoon. They become suspicious of a woman (Jenny Hu) who matches the radio bulletin description of a murderess who killed twelve men. Can she be trusted? Is she laying a trap for a local youth (Chin Han) housesitting a mansion?

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: When an Anti-Ching chief is killed, his family flees to a small town populated by quarreling students and formidable gym coaches. However, one teacher is also an undercover agent.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Cheng-ying and his sister ingratiate themselves into the life of the diabolical Lin Hao, as they plot to avenge their father's death, with a little help from the lethal titular move.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: The young emperor Kangxi is attempting to select a bride. His mother has arranged for young available women to visit him so that he may choose.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend.

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: Son Donglu, a newly promoted detective teams up with Guo Zhui, fastest gunman in Tiancheng and Xiaowu, a novice policeman to investigate the mystery deaths in a bullet factory.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: The Medallion

programme.title: Rio Ngumoha : The Big Interview
programme.desc: At just 16 years and 361 days old, Rio Ngumoha became Liverpool's youngest ever goalscorer, scoring a 100th minute winner on his Premier League debut at Newcastle. The records kept on falling in the 2025/26 season as the young winger went from wonderkid to first team regular. The East Londoner reflects on his meteoric rise and the importance of family support along the way.

programme.title: The Tigers Return : PL Stories
programme.desc: Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief. We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead, as they aim not just to survive in the Premier League, but to establish themselves there for years to come.

programme.title: Hull City V Brighton & Hove Albion / Liverpool V Manchester United : Premier League LIVE
programme.desc: Premier League Live will be pitch-side at Anfield as the two most successful clubs in English football meet again when Liverpool host Manchester United. That clash at Anfield follows high-flying Brighton's trip to Hull City.

programme.title: (Subbed) Nemanja Matic : PL Stories
programme.desc: We follow Nemanja Matic's journey from his upbringing in Serbia to Premier League success with Chelsea and his time at Manchester United. He reflects on the experiences that shaped him, the challenges of establishing himself at the highest level and the managers who influenced his career. Through his story, we explore what it took to become a key figure in midfield for club and country.

programme.title: The Evolution Of The Premier League Goalkeepper : The Art Of...
programme.desc: Peter and Kasper Schmeichel explore how the art of goalkeeping has evolved throughout the Premier League era. From the fundamentals of shot-stopping, positioning and commanding the penalty area to the modern demands of distribution and playing with the ball at your feet, the Schmeichels break down what it takes to be an elite goalkeeper. Featuring some of the Premier League's greatest number ones, the show examines how one of football's most specialised positions has been transformed.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.title: Podróż do świata Calcio
programme.desc: Oczami sędziegoPodróż do świata Calcio.

programme.title: Najlepsi dryblerzy Bundesligi
programme.desc: Szybcy napastnicy mijający obrońców niczym slalomowe tyczki to nie tylko domena ligi hiszpańskiej. W historii Bundesligi także nie brakowało świetnie wyszkolonych technicznie snajperów, którzy bez wątpienia zasługiwali na miano czarodziejów dryblingu.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: US Sassuolo Calcio - Genoa CFC
programme.desc: US Sassuolo Calcio czeka na ligowe zwycięstwo od ponad dwóch miesięcy. W ostatnich siedmiu spotkaniach zanotowało sześć porażek i jeden remis. Po tej niekorzystnej serii doszło do zmiany na ławce trenerskiej - z posadą pożegnał się Alberto Aquilani, a jego miejsce zajął Roberto D'Aversa. Pod jego wodzą zawodnicy Sassuolo zmierzą się u siebie z Genoą CFC. Goście mają za sobą porażkę 1:2 z AC Milan.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: RC Lens - Toulouse FC
programme.desc: RC Lens zanotował dwie ligowe porażki z rzędu. O powrót na zwycięską ścieżkę powalczy teraz w domowym meczu z Toulouse FC. Przyjezdni w poprzedniej kolejce pokonali RC Strasbourg 3:1. W ostatnim bezpośrednim starciu górą był RC Lens, który wygrał 4:1.

programme.title: Bundesliga
programme.desc: E10Program poświęcony rozgrywkom niemieckiej Bundesligi. Widzowie zobaczą w nim skróty najciekawszych spotkań ostatniej kolejki ligowej, wywiady z piłkarzami i trenerami oraz fachowe analizy i komentarze ekspertów.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Como 1907 - Cagliari Calcio
programme.desc: Zaskakująco dobrze spisujące się Como w poprzedniej kolejce musiało uznać wyższość Interu Mediolan (0:2). Cagliari zaś cieszyło się wreszcie wygraną po czterech kolejnych porażkach. Rossoblu pokonali 1:0 dobrze dysponowane Frosinone. Czy sprawią kolejną niespodziankę w starciu z faworyzowanymi Biancoblu?

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: FC Augsburg - 1. FSV Mainz 05
programme.desc: Liga niemiecka - mecz: FC Augsburg - 1. FSV Mainz 05.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: ESTAC Troyes - Le Havre AC
programme.desc: Walczący o wydostanie się ze strefy spadkowej gospodarze goszczą czerwoną latarnię rozgrywek. Le Havre w dotychczasowych dziesięciu seriach gier nie odniósł jeszcze zwycięstwa, zdobywając dwa punkty za remisy. Troyes spisywało się nieco lepiej, notując dwie wygrane i dwa remisy.

programme.title: Najlepsi obrońcy Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Biografie najlepszych obrońców lat 90., którzy trwale zapisali się w historii niemieckiej ekstraklasy. Widzowie poznają życiorysy takich piłkarzy, jak: Mike Werner, Lothar Matthäus, Thomas Helmer, Matthias Sammer czy Jens Nowotny.

programme.title: Potrójna korona Bayernu Monachium
programme.desc: Twórcy dokumentu przypominają historyczny sezon Bayernu Monachium, w którym bawarski zespół wygrał Bundesligę, Puchar Niemiec oraz prestiżową Ligę Mistrzów.

programme.title: Najlepsi bramkarze Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Biografie najlepszych bramkarzy lat 90., którzy zapisali się w historii niemieckiej ekstraklasy. Widzowie poznają życiorysy Olivera Kahna, Gabora Kiraly'a, Jensa Lehmanna czy Dirka Heynena.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole Borussii Dortmund
programme.desc: Michael Zorc, Stéphane Chapuisat, Robert Lewandowski, Andreas Moller to tylko niektórzy spośród piłkarzy Borussii Dortmund, którzy potrafili zdobywać bramki w zadziwiający sposób. W programie widzowie zobaczą najładniejsze gole w wykonaniu zawodników BVB.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Estrela Amadora - SL Benfica
programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Olympique Marsylia - Le Mans FC
programme.desc: Gospodarze po słabym początku sezonu zakasali rękawy i wzięli się do piłkarskiej roboty, wygrywając ostanie pięć spotkań. Teraz zmierzą się z zespołem Le Mans, który ciuła punkty, by wydobyć się ze strefy spadkowej. Czy goście będą w stanie przeciwstawić się rozpędzonym Olimpijczykom z Marsylii?

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: AC Monza - ACF Fiorentina
programme.desc: AC Monza w poprzedniej kolejce musiała uznać wyższość Atalanty BC, przegrywając 0:1. Dla Biancorossich była to już czwarta ligowa porażka z rzędu. Przełamania będą teraz szukać w starciu z ACF Fiorentiną, choć zadanie nie wydaje się łatwe. Mimo że Fioletowi mieli w tym sezonie swoje problemy, ostatnio punktowali w trzech kolejnych spotkaniach, notując dwa remisy i zwycięstwo.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Estrela Amadora - SL Benfica
programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Partizan - Besiktas
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Athletic Bilbao - Espanyol
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. Along with the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the highly technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Košarka - Turska liga: Besiktas - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: Sami počeci turske košarke sežu daleko pre osnivanja lige 1966. godine. Još početkom 20. veka loptanje pod obručima je bilo poznato u Turskoj. Studenti sa Rober koledža u Istanbulu 1904. godine su prvi put otkrili čari ovog ekipnog sporta. Godinu nakon osnivanja lige započelo je i prvo službeno takmičenje najboljih turskih košarkaških klubova. Tri godine kasnije pokrenuta je i druga liga. Današnji sistem takmičenja se sastoji od šesnaest ekipa koja igra svaka sa svakim dva puta u regularnom delu nakon kojeg sledi plejof osam najboljih ekipa. Iz prve lige ispadaju dve najslabije plasirane ekipe.
